name: windows-10-portfolio-os
description: Full-Stack Windows 10 Portfolio OS built with Node.js, Express, SQLite, and Vanilla Web OS Shell

scripts.lint: node --check server.js perf-audit.js public/js/main.js public/js/core/*.js public/js/system/*.js public/js/apps/*.js public/js/utils/*.js src/*.js src/**/*.js tests/**/*.js
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('✅ Build verification passed: Server and static frontend assets ready.')"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit/math-evaluator.test.js tests/unit/state-manager.test.js tests/unit/utilities.test.js tests/unit/error-handling.test.js tests/unit/observability.test.js
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:all

author: Bhavy
